title: Maximum Floor Area Ratio
previewText:

blocks.html: Any given lot area shall be counted only once in determining the floor area ratio.
blocks.plainText: Any given lot area shall be counted only once in determining the floor area ratio.

blocks.html: Where floor area in a building is shared by multiple uses, the floor area for such shared portion shall be attributed to each use proportionately, based on the percentage each use occupies of the total floor area of the zoning lot less any shared floor area.
blocks.plainText: Where floor area in a building is shared by multiple uses, the floor area for such shared portion shall be attributed to each use proportionately, based on the percentage each use occupies of the total floor area of the zoning lot less any shared floor area.

blocks.html: Except where authorized by express provisions of this Resolution, the maximum floor area ratio shall not exceed the amount set forth in this Section by more than 20 percent.
blocks.plainText: Except where authorized by express provisions of this Resolution, the maximum floor area ratio shall not exceed the amount set forth in this Section by more than 20 percent.

blocks.html: In addition, the following limitations on maximum permitted floor area shall apply:

(a)        In contextual Commercial Districts

In the districts indicated, and in C1 and C2 Districts mapped within R9A, R9D, R9X, R10A, R10X or R11A Districts, no floor area bonuses are permitted.
blocks.plainText: (a) In contextual Commercial Districts In the districts indicated, and in C1 and C2 Districts mapped within R9A, R9D, R9X, R10A, R10X or R11A Districts, no floor area bonuses are permitted.

blocks.html:
(b)        In Community Board 7, Borough of Manhattan

Within the boundaries of Community Board 7 in Manhattan, in R10 equivalent Commercial Districts without a letter suffix, the maximum floor area ratio shall not exceed 10.0.
blocks.plainText: (b) In Community Board 7, Borough of Manhattan Within the boundaries of Community Board 7 in Manhattan, in R10 equivalent Commercial Districts without a letter suffix, the maximum floor area ratio shall not exceed 10.0.

blocks.html:
(c)        In C6-1A Districts

In C6-1A Districts, the maximum floor area ratio shall not exceed the amount set forth in this Section by more than 50 percent.
blocks.plainText: (c) In C6-1A Districts In C6-1A Districts, the maximum floor area ratio shall not exceed the amount set forth in this Section by more than 50 percent.

blocks.html:
(d)        In C6-4X Districts

In C6-4X Districts, a floor area bonus shall only be permitted for a public plaza pursuant to Section 33-13.
blocks.plainText: (d) In C6-4X Districts In C6-4X Districts, a floor area bonus shall only be permitted for a public plaza pursuant to Section 33-13.
